simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פָּלִיל (H6414) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פָּלִיל (pâlîyl) means a magistrate First listed occurrence: Deut 32 31.

definitions.full: H6414. palil [ מָּלִיל ] noun masculine judge ; plural מְּלִילִים Deut 32:31 our enemies being judges, umpires ; פ ׳עָוֺן Job 31:11 , read פ ׳עֲוֺן according to Di Siegf, compare De; < מְּלִילִי עָוֺן as 31:28 , so Bu Du; בִּפְלִלִים Exod 21:22 , read perhaps בַּנְּפָלִים for the abortion Bu ZAW xi (1891), 107 , compare also Di-Ry.
